target_customer: Web3 apps, wallets, onramps and marketplaces that want to give users self-custody smart account wallets
problem: Crypto wallets are hard for users; account abstraction can add gas-free transactions, bundling and programmable security.
business_model: Developer infrastructure SaaS with paid plans (Growth tier) for smart accounts, bundling and paymaster

founders.name: Derek Chiang
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him founder of ZeroDev (W23, acquired) and Eternal (W20).

technical_complexity.rationale: Smart contract accounts (the Kernel account), bundler and paymaster infrastructure on ERC-4337 required security critical Solidity and infrastructure work.

defensibility.rationale: Kernel became widely adopted and integrated (300+ apps claimed), giving integration lock in, but standards are open and rivals offered similar stacks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Offchain Labs, the Arbitrum developer, acquired ZeroDev in August 2025 and the product continues under Offchain.

market_need_then: ERC-4337 account abstraction was still being rolled out in early 2023; the pain of seed phrases and gas fees in wallet UX was widely discussed but mainstream adoption was unproven.

branding.name_origin: Company says Kernel, its account contract, borrows operating system language; no source for the ZeroDev name itself.
branding.domain_note: Uses zerodev.app; no domain history found.

identity.logo: Wordmark and logo mark, brand kit page on site

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is functional developer tooling; no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: ZeroDev built the Kernel smart account and wallet infrastructure and grew to a claimed 300 plus apps and 10M plus smart accounts. Offchain Labs acquired it in August 2025 with undisclosed terms and the team continues the product. The ERC-4337 tailwind and an adopted open account standard drove the exit. Funding before the sale appears small, with only aggregator reports.
notes: Directory status says Active while the YC page and press say acquired by Offchain Labs; exit is recorded as acquisition. Date varies Aug 12 or 13, 2025 across sources so only the month is given. VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in April 2023 with YC and Orange DAO, and CB Insights lists $1M over 4 rounds; aggregator only, unverified. Competitors named in 2026 articles (Biconomy, Alchemy, StackUp, Candide, Pimlico) lack sources dated near the batch, so the list is empty. One profile claims Chiang joined Ethlabs in 2026, a single unverified source.
